text:
emily: Quick heads-up — planning to publish Python SDK 1.5.0 and TS SDK 2.0.0 in ~90m during the change window.
emily: TS has the async-only client change; Python will deprecate the legacy sync client. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> GA for each.
emily: Need: rollback criteria, pin/fallback plan for Dedicated, and someone to own release notes. @sam @jia please ack. :eyes:
sam: Ack — I'll drive the deploy-bot run. Can you paste exact package names / dist-tags and the embargo window?
emia: (typo) meant emily: Window is 18:00–20:00 PT. Packages: see below.
emily: ```
Py: pip install redwood==1.5.0
Dist-tag: pypi "stable" points to 1.5.0 after GA
TS: npm publish @redwood/sdk@2.0.0
Dist-tag: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 next
Deprecation: package `redwood-sync` marked deprecated after py GA
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary schedule queued for 3130123456-cb-202603, targets: python:1.5.0 (5%), ts:2.0.0 (5%). ETA start: +2m.
jia: Heads-up — staging smoke failed for TS 2.0.0 on the quick connect test. Short log: ```
TypeError: client.request is not a function
 at connect (/workspace/sdk/lib/index.js:42:18)
```
jia: It looks like a breaking API surface change slipped through the shim layer. Repro steps in the PR comments.
sam: Hold TS canary. Initiating rollback for TS canary only (cb-202603-ts).
sam: deploy-bot, run: rollback canary cb-202603-ts and revert dist-tag to 1.9.4
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback started for cb-202603-ts. Removing 2.0.0 from 'next' dist-tag and reassigning previous artifact. Status: in-progress.
sam: Commands used: ```
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.4 next
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk 2.0.0 || true
```
emily: OK TS pause acknowledged. We'll proceed with Python canary for now if ops can pin fallback on Dedicated and keep the sync package available.
ops: Pinning fallback: pinned redwood@1.4.12 to 'fallback' pool on dedicated. Command run: ```
curl -X POST https://internal.ops/api/pins -d '{"package":"redwood","version":"1.4.12","pool":"fallback"}'
```
ops: Added TTL 24h; can extend if needed.
harry: I'll update the release notes and changelog. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7890 — will mark TS as delayed and call out the deprecation timeline for redwood-sync.
emily: Breaking changes to call out in notes (short):
- TS: removed sync client, moved to async-only API; rename `connect()` -> `openSession()` in several helpers.
- Py: deprecate `RedwoodSyncClient`; keep available for two minor releases with deprecation warnings.
sam: Rollback criteria we agreed on:
- error rate > 2% for request types that historically are <0.5%
- any sign-off test (smoke/e2e) failures in production canaries
- checksum/signature mismatch on published artifact
- immediate rollback on auth regression impacting >1% of requests

emily: Monitoring hooks: please ensure token-level latency and error-rate dashboards have alert thresholds: 2% errors or +30ms p50 delta. @ops @jia
ops: Alerts wired. Also added a quick-run playbook to unpin and reassign tags.
sam: Final plan: Publish Py 1.5.0 canary (5%) now, monitor 30m; advance to 25% if no regressions. TS GA postponed until fixes merged — we'll re-run canary when PR passes.
emily: Agree. Action items: sam (deploy), harry (release notes), jia (regression fix for TS), ops (pin fallback & alerts).
emily: If any of the rollback triggers fire call the rollback playbook and ping #eng-oncall + #devex.
emily: :white_check_mark: proceeding with Py canary. Will post deploy-bot confirmation in-thread when it starts.
